optimize_poses: optimize camera poses and depth transforms jointly for a depth video using the PoseOptimizer class
convert_opt_params: convert a Nestedspace configuration object into a DepthVideoPoseOptimizer.Params struct for pose optimization
copy_poses: copy camera poses and intrinsics from one depth stream to another within a DepthVideo
duplicate_last_depth_stream: duplicate the last depth stream with its poses and depth maps into a new named stream
filter_depth: apply a flow-guided filter to the last depth stream and save the filtered result as a new stream
